lines.en: Jana, the lovely fairy,
has covered her white face,
has covered her white face,
her blue eyes are filled with tears.
In the sky the stars wove a carpet,
and wove sorrow for her soul,
because they were preparing Jana the maiden
to be given to another.
Just one great wish,
squeezes her heart like a marble rock,

lines.cyr: да го види либето што го милува.

lines.en: to see the sweetheart she loves.
All the tears she has shed,

lines.cyr: да се сторат бели птици, гулаби,
